ModMetaData.name: Gualaar Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description: Replaces Mlie.StarWarsAnimalCollection's Gualaar art (bodyGraphicData texPath swanimals/Gualaar/Gualaar) with custom generated art per the 2026-09-16 owner ruling on OFFBIOME_SHEET_RERENDERS_1 ("gualaar: rerender"). Gualaar ships as pure donor content with no owned ThingDef port yet, so this is a loose-art override, not a def port. The pack-saddle variant (Gualaarpack_*) and the dessicated-corpse texture (Gualaar_Dessicated) stay on donor art. LABEL/ART ONLY - no defName touched, no Defs, no Patches, loose Textures/ only, same relative path the donor uses, so this mod's later load order wins the same-path resolution.
